cohort: The study included 321 newborns with suspected hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) from a 14-center collaborative NE Registry.
finding: Both numeric neonatal encephalopathy (NE) scores showed a significant correlation with neurophysiology (aEEG and cEEG), with higher NE scores associated with more abnormal EEG patterns, and HIE severity evolving in most newborns within 6 hours after birth.
